value: Base-load LNG liquefaction plant: removes impurities (S, CO2, H2O, O2) and recovers natural gas liquids, then cools and liquefies the gas at -162 degC in a refrigerant cycle whose compressors are usually driven by gas turbines fired on natural gas. The most expensive link of the LNG chain (30-45% of chain cost)

note: Established technology; over 240 bcm traded as LNG in 2008 (p.3).
